title: Animal Crossing's island joins the programme
body: Animal Crossing: New Horizons has a server on the island. It runs against a real database, builds its own schemas plus the shared matchmaking and tracking libraries, and answers the protocols the game knows. No console has visited yet — that is the next stamp in the passport. As with every NEX title in the programme, the honest status is: the lights are on, the door is unlocked, and the first visitor will teach us the most.
